decisions.reason: The Trivital supplement range builds on the firm's pharmacy consumer-health business and fits its strategy of broadening consumer health products, so the line is likely kept even if individual variants are trimmed.
Skin and hair supplements sell steadily in pharmacies and cost little to keep within the existing Trivital line.
Joint health is an established, ageing-driven pharmacy category that fits the brand, so the product is likely kept.
The immune supplement probably gained demand during the pandemic years, although as a niche mushroom-based product it is somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning.

Despite the 2018 Valsartan contamination recall that hit the whole industry, a blood pressure generic is a high-volume product that fits the broad generics range, so it is likely kept if supply is sourced cleanly.
An over-the-counter triptan is a differentiated consumer health product with steady pharmacy demand and supports the firm's strategy of expanding into new consumer health products.
